title: Drumming on the steps and first drum set
summary: He began beating on box steps with chair rounds at six or seven and bought his first drum set at about fourteen.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Getting my first drums, with or without lessons

blocks.x: What was the first instrument you played? Did you start on drums or...?
Well, I tell you, I started my career as a drummer beating on the steps. You see, like these box steps they have?
Yeah, a lot of kids. Kicking the side of the box.
Yeah. Used to take the rounds off a chair, you know what I mean? Yeah.
And whistle a tune, you know, and kick the side of the step.
That was your bass drum. Bass drumming. Played this. Yeah, pretty good. That's right. How old were you, I guess, just a little kid when you started doing that?
Well, I imagine I must have been around about six or seven years old, somewhere along.
When did you get your first drum set? Can you remember that?
Well, I remember I bought my first drum set when I was around about 14 years old.
Did you get the whole set or just the snare or something first?
First I bought the snare, then I bought the stand and the bass drum, you know what I mean? So it touched like that.
